title: Leviath agent blueprint (agent.leviath)
description: The TOML manifest defining a Leviath agent: its stages, the model each one runs on, the tools it may call, and the shape of its context. Written against the parser in crates/leviath-core/src/manifest.rs, and checked against every bundled blueprint by a test in crates/leviath-cli/src/bundled.rs. See https://leviath.dev/docs/agents.

stages.description: One entry per stage, keyed by stage name.

regions.description: One entry per context region, keyed by region name.

security.description: Taint tracking for this blueprint. A machine-wide ceiling still applies.

read_paths.description: Paths outside the workdir this agent may read. Inert until the host grants them under [agent_read_paths] in config.toml.

items.description: An exact path (granting its subtree), `glob:<pattern>`, or `regex:<pattern>` (auto-anchored). `~/` expands; a relative path resolves against the workdir.

safe_commands.description: Tools and shell command prefixes this agent would like to run without an approval prompt. Inert until the host opts in under [agent_safe_commands.<name>] allow_blueprint or [security] allow_blueprint_safe_commands in config.toml.

items.description: A tool name, exactly as the model calls it.
A program, optionally with the subcommand that narrows it: "rg", "cargo test". No flags, arguments, redirects, quotes or chained commands.

compaction.description: The model that summarizes a compacting region. Skipped without error when its provider is not registered, so a run on another provider loses compaction rather than failing.

transforms.description: How context maps when one blueprint hands off to another.

entry_stage.description: The stage a run starts in. Defaults to the first stage declared.

outputSpec.description: What shape the run's final output should take. Declared by the agent, narrowed by a stage, and overridable by whoever starts the run.

format.description: A label for the shape, carried to the model and recorded beside the answer. Deliberately not an enum: any value is valid, and one the engine has never seen is simply not parsed. json, xml, yaml, csv and toml get a free well-formedness check; anything else needs a validator to be checked at all.

instructions.description: Free-form guidance folded into the submit_output tool description and the stage's system prompt. Where a format the model has never seen gets explained.

example.description: A literal sample shown to the model verbatim. The most effective lever for an unusual format, and the reason one needs no code support.

schema.description: A JSON Schema describing the answer's shape. Separate from format, which asks only whether the answer parses. A failing submission is refused back to the model to correct.

validator.description: A .rhai script deciding whether an answer is valid, as a path relative to the blueprint directory. For a format the engine cannot parse and a shape a JSON Schema cannot describe. Defines fn validate(content), returning () when fine or a string saying what is wrong. Compiled at spawn, so a broken script fails fast.

mode.description: How the stage runs. `interactive_points` holds at each declared interaction point. `output` produces the run's final answer and nothing else. An unrecognized value is a load error, not a silent fallback to autonomous.

available_tools.description: The only tools the model is offered here. Anything absent is refused at dispatch.

require_output.description: This stage must call submit_output before it transitions. Unlike required_tools, which is never checked afterwards, this is enforced: a stage that finishes without submitting is nudged and re-run, bounded, then let through with the run's output_forced flag set. `mode = "output"` sets it for you.
require_output.$comment: A stage that sets this must also grant submit_output; lev validate refuses it otherwise.

required_tools.description: Tools this stage cannot work without. Every entry must also appear in available_tools. Survives an unattended run, where the blocking interaction tools are otherwise withheld.

tool_routing.description: Where a tool result lands in context.

overrides.description: Tool name to a region name, or to a table carrying that tool's region, its result ceiling, or both.

max_result_tokens_per_tool.description: Tool name to that tool's result ceiling, overriding max_result_tokens for it.

transitions.description: Outgoing edges, keyed by target stage name. An empty table marks a terminal stage.

results_region.description: Context region the consolidated worker report is written to. Defaults to conversation, which is also carrying the message history. Worth naming when the results are bulky: the region's budget is what each worker's share is divided from.

max_items.description: Most work items the split may produce. Distinct from max_workers, which caps how many run at once. This caps how many exist at all, bounding both the run's cost and each worker's share of the results region.

modelConfig.description: Which model this stage runs on. `models` is an ordered fallback list: the first entry whose provider is registered wins.

provider.description: Back-compat shorthand for a single-entry `models` list.

fallbacks.description: Back-compat: folded onto the end of `models`.

allow_user_default.description: Whether the host's default model may be used when nothing listed is registered.

parameters.description: Passed to the provider verbatim, so the accepted keys are the provider's.

provider.description: A registered provider name. The built-ins are anthropic, openai, google, openrouter, ollama, and claude-code; a Rhai provider resolves by its script name.

model.description: Passed to the provider verbatim and never validated locally, so a typo surfaces on the first live call.

region.description: One region of the context window. Budgets are ceilings, not allocations, and may sum past 100%.

kind.description: Omitted means `temporary`. An unrecognised value is a hard parse error.

budget.description: A percentage of the window, as a string such as "35%".

summarizable.description: Set false to keep an edge transform = "compact" from handing this region to the summarizer. Protects the region wherever it is used, and wins over an explicit compact list.

required_message.description: Shown when a required region is empty. `{region}` interpolates.

script.description: For `kind = "custom"`: the Rhai script under context_hooks/.

regionSeed.description: What fills the region at spawn. The table form is checked key by key in the order below, so the first one present wins.

oneOf.description: A caller-input key, such as "task", filled from --task or a --<region> flag.

glob.description: Concatenated contents of the workdir files matching this pattern.

files.description: Concatenated contents of these workdir-relative paths.

literal.description: Verbatim text baked into the blueprint.

rhai.description: A Rhai script in the workdir whose returned String fills the region.

command.description: A shell command run at spawn. The only seed that executes anything, and it runs before the first inference and so before any approval prompt. Gated by [security] allow_seed_commands and --no-seed-commands.

caller.description: The caller-input key to fill from, the table form of the plain string.

transition.description: One outgoing edge. A `hint` with no `condition` implies `llm_choice`.

hint.description: Told to the model when it is choosing where to go next.

condition.description: An unrecognised value is a hard parse error.

transform.description: What happens to context on this edge. `custom` reads transform_config. Anything else is a hard parse error rather than a silent downgrade to `direct`.

gate.description: A condition the stage must satisfy before this edge may be taken.

require_regions.description: Regions that must all hold content before this edge may be taken. ANDed with every other condition on the gate, unlike `region`.

require_region_updated.description: A region that must have changed during this stage, not merely be present. For a revise loop, where re-emitting the same content would satisfy a presence check.

require_no_open_items.description: A checklist region that must have no open items before this edge is taken.

region.description: An alternative way to satisfy require_modifications: the gate also passes when this region is non-empty. A restart-durable stand-in for the per-stage counters, not a requirement - use require_regions for that.

interactionPoint.description: A checkpoint the runtime raises at the stage boundary, every time, rather than one the model chooses to raise.

unattended.description: What a --yolo run does here. `auto_approve` (the default) resolves it without asking. `ask` holds for a person even unattended, and the run then waits for [limits] interaction_timeout_secs.

directives.description: Option text to the instruction added when it is picked.

abort_options.description: Options that end the run immediately, with no further inference.

edit_options.description: Options that open the document for the user to edit directly.

document_region.description: The pinned region holding what this point is about. Replaced with the current text each time the point is presented.

toolPermissions.description: Tool name to policy. May only tighten the machine-wide ceiling in config.toml, never loosen it. `ask` blocks until answered.

sandbox.description: Where tools execute. An agent and a stage resolve to the stronger of the pair.

nudge.description: What to say to a stage that has gone quiet. Cascades stage over agent over config.

stageHooks.description: Rhai scripts run at points in this stage's lifecycle. Each value is a script path relative to the agent directory.
